liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Scarlet Begonias** (2 reviews): Reviewer recalls shaky sets and flubbed verses in Scarlet Begonias; Reviewer judges the Scarlet>Fire excellent [18][23]
- **Walk Me Out In The) Morning Dew** (2 reviews): Reviewer says the Morning Dew was so powerful it blew the roof off the building; Reviewer hears Jerry pouring his heart out in Morning Dew, playing as though it might be his last [14][16]
- **Just Exactly Perfectly"** (1 other source): Down in the Boondocks tuning is played while striding toward Just Exactly Perfect [3]
- **Row Jimmy** (1 review): Reviewer calls this a very good Row Jimmy [23]
- **Fire On The Mountain** (1 review): Reviewer praises the Scarlet to Fire transition for about two minutes of exceptional musical space [24]
- **Supplication Jam** (1 review): Reviewer was pleased to see Supplication played, and thought Scarlet was almost good [22]
- **U.S. Blues** (1 review): Jerry nearly gets through U.S. Blues without botching the lyrics [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1995-06-21.fob.schoeps.sisler.stephens.76664.sbeok.flac1648** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 163 min; rated 3.67/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd1995-06-21.141512.OTS.AKG.Ackerman.Miller.Noel.t-flac.1648**: audience recording; 18 songs; 156 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd95-06-21.naks.5971.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 17 songs; 163 min; rated 3.14/5 by 37 [5]. Said about its sound: Audience recording sounds good, with clear low end that brings out Phil's bass; Reviewer finds the audience recording good in sound quality, despite disliking the performance; Reviewer describes the shn files as exceptionally good: flat across the range, muscular lows, soaring highs [16][17][19][24]
- **gd1995-06-21.148797.nak300-cp4.boedicker.flac1644**: source not stated; 17 songs; 160 min [8]. Said about its sound: Tape flip after Row Jimmy lost no music; some wow and flutter affects second-set tuning and part of Scarlet Begonias [8]

## Around the show

- Between sets Jerry stood with his back to the crowd for about 20 minutes, fiddling with his guitar rig, puzzling fans [18]
- Reviewer says Jerry stood at the equipment stack because he was angrily berating a tech [20]
- Standing behind the stage, reviewer heard a fan scream abuse at Bobby not to play Easy Answers as it began [22]
- Reviewer, who attended, reads Jerry's fretting over his equipment as a sign he badly wanted to sound good [23]
- First set runs about 50 minutes; second set and encore run roughly 95 minutes [5]
- Uploader sat about ten rows up beside Vince Welnick's side of the stage, bringing his girlfriend to her first Dead shows [8]
- Reviewer finds the show far tighter and better than the sloppy 1995 norm, calling it the last of the real Dead [14]
- Reviewer calls it a below-average 1995 show, among the worst heard, with Jerry in poor form throughout [17]
- Uploader notes this was the final Man Smart (Woman Are Smarter) and the final Supplication Jam, last played 08-14-91 [3]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1995-06-21.fob.schoeps.sisler.stephens.76664.sbeok.flac1648**: taped by Dan Sisler; transferred by Dan Stephens; source: Schoeps MK4 > Reutelhuber P/S > Denon DTR-80P > Sony TCD-D7 [1]
- **gd1995-06-21.141512.OTS.AKG.Ackerman.Miller.Noel.t-flac.1648**: taped by Ray Ackerman; transferred by Charlie Miller and Joe Noel; source: flac16/48kHz ; Master Audience Recording & Transfer by Ray Ackerman: AKG 460B/CK63 ULS > AKG B18 phantom power unit > Panasonic SV250 > DAT (OTS); Transfer… [3]
- **gd95-06-21.naks.5971.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Dan Stephens; source: Audience: Nakamichi 300's w/CP-4 caps [5]. Also: Taped with Nakamichi 300s and CP-4 caps into a modified Sony TCD-D7; transferred via Tascam DA-20mkII, SBLive, to SHN by Dan Stephens [5]
- **gd1995-06-21.148797.nak300-cp4.boedicker.flac1644**: taped by Andy Trate; transferred by Dave Boedicker; source: Source:Nakamichi 300 Mics W/CP4 Shotguns>Sony TC-D5M Cassette Deck(Lead Deck)>Sony Wm-D6C Cassette Deck>2 Casssette Master Tapes(Maxell XL-2-S 90 Minute… [8]. Also: Taper skipped recording; friend Andy used the uploader's Nakamichi 300 CP-4 mics and deck while the owner sat in the audience [8]
